sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00703423901', '60505628201', '16729029512')

rows.notes: Same product from Apotex Corp.; substitute NDC, no clinical change.

rows.rule: same molecule, alternate concentration or vial size
rows.notes: Recalculate dose and volume; pharmacist verification required.
